customer_message.body:
Hello

Also relevant to me: I have lived here for 17 years and need a lift and a step-free shower; Six of nine enquiries were rejected; The manager says everyone must leave but sent only a general project brochure; this order reflects what I know.

Regarding “renovation-related termination with substantial accessibility and housing-search hardship”, for an initial view: the works schedule remains unresolved; for the request “review the renovation reason and schedule and prepare an extension request with documented housing searches”: I have included everything currently available to me; on “renovation-related termination with substantial accessibility and housing-search hardship”, my records may be out of order; also unresolved: the vacant possession need; I need a professional view on that.

I am asking for: review the renovation reason and schedule and prepare an extension request with documented housing searches; in particular, I need clarity about the vacant possession need and whether the records support an initial assessment.

My first note about it is dated 17 February 2025.

Thank you for clarifying; Please explain the works schedule; That will let me complete my records.

Kind regards
customer_message.subject: Question about my documents: renovation-related termination with substantial accessibility and housing-search hardship
